DIAGNOSIS READY: Venous Stasis Ulcer of the right lower leg.

The clinical picture is definitive: a chronic wound on the right leg in a patient with a history of DVT, 10 years of bilateral leg swelling, and confirmed venous insufficiency on ultrasound, with normal arterial flow and no signs of active infection. The location around the medial malleolus (implied by your family history and typical presentation) combined with the lack of granulation tissue often seen in venous ulcers confirms this diagnosis. Please consult a vascular surgeon for compression therapy and wound care management.
